regions.today: This morning will be mainly dry over Leinster. Early this afternoon, showery rain will develop in the south and will move northwards over the region through the afternoon and evening. The rain will turn heavy in places, especially in the south. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees with light to moderate easterly breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mild and mostly cloudy with showery rain continuing heavy at times. Temperatures will not fall below 13 to 16 degrees in light to moderate, occasionally fresh easterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be mostly cloudy with rain becoming light and patchy in the morning. Scattered showers in the afternoon and early evening, some heavy with isolated thunderstorms possible. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees with light to moderate east or southeast winds.
